explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/61 (the Erdős–Hajnal conjecture): for any graph H, is there c(H) > 0 such that every n-vertex graph without an induced copy of H has a clique or independent set of size ≥ n^c? The Lean statement: for every finite graph H on α, ∃ c > 0 with IsErdosHajnalLowerBound H (n ↦ n^c): eventually in n, every G on Fin n with no embedding g : α ↪ Fin n satisfying H = G.comap g (i.e. no induced copy of H) has indepNum ≥ n^c or cliqueNum ≥ n^c. 'Sufficiently large n' is harmless (small n are absorbed by shrinking c), and degenerate H (e.g. empty vertex set) make the hypothesis unsatisfiable, hence trivially true. Faithful (positive form of the question).
